comparison.objective: Place snowboard bindings at specified stance positions and angles; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Pose measurement and flat placement versus articulated long-rail handling, compliant latch insertion, telescoping adjustment, and tool change.
comparison.success_condition: Binding spacing, centering, angle, flatness, stillness, and release versus mechanically retained front/rear prongs and correct screws.
comparison.reason: The binding task is precision placement without mechanical engagement; candidate success depends on staged load-bearing latches.
